branches.head: 908d53d70d6b95784a92e9f1746ab5b13afcfdf0

commits.message: Rotation, Scaling, and Screen Projection Skies!
Updates to Architecture conversion to C# plan
v0.7A - Working Editor with Fewer Obstructions

Almost Done

Major updates to windows and rendering

SED Updates

Done (all formats + editing): JKL 9-section read/write, GOB read/write, MAT/CMP/3DO, Vulkan renderer, undo system, 2D map view, multi-select/box-select/copy-paste, lighting calc, inspectors, find, header/template/layer/COG editors, consistency checker, plugin model.

Monsters and NPCs

Monsters and NPCs now convert, not just read. FruaCharacter carries the 22 further fields the two import paths need (abilities, THAC0, size, the two trait-flag bytes, class levels pre-drain and pre-class-change), and FruaCharacterConverter implements both branches of ImportMonsterToUAF: race == 6 && combatMode == 1 becomes a MonsterRecord, everything else a CharacterRecord. FruaMonsterTraits names the four engine bitfields FRUA's fourteen trait bits scatter across. The plan now documents the conversion layer as its own thing, with the three findings that produce a design which loads.
